thread:
riley: Beginning v2.18 deploy. Feature flag plan: toggle `serve-v2` OFF->canary(3%) then step to 15% after 20m, final 100% in overnight window if stable. Change window 21:30-22:45 UTC.

 deploy-bot: [deploy] v2.18 started on prod-west-1. Canary cohort: cohort-llm-tier2.

 devops: Pin model for canary to `rwd-model-2026-04-02` to avoid model drift during progressive rollouts. Command: `/infra pin-model --service rec --version rwd-model-2026-04-02`

 riley: kicking off 3% now: `/ff set serve-v2 --target 3 --reason "v2.18 canary initial"`

 deploy-bot: 3% -> success. Telemetry snapshot: error-rate delta +0.05%, p95 +9ms, kv-cache hit 89%. Auto-circuit thresholds: error_delta >1.0% OR p95 +200ms OR node_mem > 80%.

 maria: posting release notes: https://confluence.redwood/release/v2.18 :page_facing_up: Also noted known minor ranking drift in staging only.

 ops-oncall: on watch. Muting noisy alerts, keeping a pager for sev>=high. Quick-run checks: 5m error rate, request latency, embedding queue.

 deploy-bot: advancing to 15% in 20m as scheduled unless flagged.

 riley: small pre-step: enabling debug logs for cohort-internal for 10m to capture any edge cases: `/infra set-log-level --service rec --cohort internal --level debug --duration 600s`

 ops-oncall: gotcha. If we see error_delta >= 0.8% or sustained p95 increase >120ms, we cut to 0% and rollback. Rollback steps in runbook.

 deploy-bot: 15% -> success. Telemetry stable: error +0.2%, p95 +22ms, mem 66%.

 release-manager: recommend hold 45m at 15% to validate latencies under evening traffic. If good, schedule 100% for 02:00 UTC.

 devops: abort/rollback snippet for oncall (curl): `curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" "https://api.redwood/flags/serve-v2?action=set&target=0&force=true"`

 ops-oncall: smoke at 15% looks clean after 30m. No SLO regressions. Approving 100% plan contingent on overnight low-load window.

 riley: thanks. I'll post a final go/no-go thread before the 02:00 flip. If we abort, immediate actions: 1) `/ff set serve-v2 --target 0 --force` 2) `/infra rollback-release --id v2.18` 3) `/infra unpin-model --service rec`

 deploy-bot: noted. Will post final status at flip time.
